watches.name: The Fusion - Denim Fire
watches.description: A very special Fusion created for members of Second Hour HQ. Very limited in number and featuring a sunburst denim dial, layered with gloss enamel lacquer, accented by fire orange accents, it's something very special to see. Put simply, it’s a watch you’ll never want to take off. Each Denim Fire ships on our in house designed 7-link bracelet, with an additional two piece cloth strap included for you to mix and match as you please. We know you'll get major enjoyment from this beautiful cloth strap as we’ve carefully pantone matched it with the dial for maximum visual impact. Sleek, svelte lines combine with stylishly appealing dials and surface hardening for superior protection from the wear and tear of daily life. The Fusion draws together the ultra sleek case form and superlative bracelet of the Sattelberg Mk2 with the exhaustive details and playful colours of the Mandala, creating something new and distinct. With its fusion case back that artfully captures the merging of two circular forms – reflecting its design origins - the Fusion plays its own game and will impress with its incredible fit and finish, and our always beautiful dials and hands. Key Specs Case Material : 316L Stainless Steel Case Treatment:1200 Vickers surface hardening - case, bracelet and clasp Case Diameter : 40mm Lug to Lug : 47mm Thickness : 10.5mm (with crystal) Lug Width : 20mm Crystal : Flat Sapphire crystal with 6 layers of internal AR coating Movement : regulated Miyota 9015 Automatic (42 hours power reserve) Water Resistance : 100 metres with screw down crown Additional Information Lume : Swiss SuperLuminova BGW9 Bracelet : screw pin, 7 link bracelet with quick release spring bars Clasp: push button micro-adjustment, fully milled Inclusions : Screwdriver and shipped in our hard wearing, custom made, zip up travel case Warranty : two year international warranty Available now
